approved_in_principle: researcher 2026-11-08: plan A (train 1000), ratios 100:0/75:25/50:50/25:75/0:100, moderate augmentation approved in principle; full training NOT authorised

qa.role: analysis only (H1); never a training input

box_loss_precision: fp32: bbox_decode + BboxLoss (CIoU, DFL) with autocast disabled on float32 inputs

amendment.unchanged: network forward AMP, cls BCE, mask/seg loss, GradScaler init_scale 128, all train_args (epochs 200, batch 64, lr0 0.001, ...), seeds, data, labels, QA
side_effects: decoded pred boxes fed to the TaskAlignedAssigner are fp32 instead of fp16 (assignment may differ marginally)
validation loss (EMA model, Ultralytics validator) still uses the default criterion; val metrics unaffected
amendment.reason: v02 HR seed-42 FAILED at epoch 182 with intermittent inf box loss (9 batches, epochs 107-182). Unit test shows the fp16-pred/fp32-target CIoU path yields iou>1, alpha denominator<=0, CIoU=-inf and negative losses for near-perfect boxes; fp32 path yields none. Not proven to be the only cause in training.
amendment.audit_policy: trainer v05: every batch audited; non-finite forward loss vs AMP gradient-overflow skip distinguished; any non-finite forward loss -> run state FLAGGED_NONFINITE_FORWARD (not PASS); abort on non-finite weights, 3 consecutive non-finite forward batches, scale < 2^-8, or non-finite val metric

custom_photometric.implementation: trainer v06 (planned): image-only cv2/numpy transform inserted after RandomPerspective/flip and before Format, train dataset only; labels/masks untouched; albumentations not installed and will not be installed
custom_photometric.rng: per-sample numpy Generator seeded from (run seed, epoch, index) for reproducibility

excluded_augmentations.flipud: gravity: pallet always below the load
excluded_augmentations.shear_perspective: distorts brick geometry and pallet footprint
excluded_augmentations.mosaic: cuts loads at tile borders, changes instance layout; real labels mark one target per image so tiles with unlabeled loads would add label noise
excluded_augmentations.copy_paste: floating loads without pallets; inconsistent with real single-target labelling
excluded_augmentations.large_hue_grayscale: colour is a key cue for red clay vs cement
excluded_augmentations.random_erasing: not applied to segmentation in Ultralytics; occlusion would need mask-consistent handling

validation_each_epoch: real val 48 (second Ultralytics SegmentationValidator on a deep copy of the EMA model; same metric code)
checkpoints_saved: best_combined.pt (PRIMARY: max of 0.5*(B1 val mask mAP50-95 + real val mask mAP50-95), ties earliest)
model_selection: PRIMARY best_combined.pt for all mixing cells (100:0 ... 0:100). Q1 (augmentation vs the existing no-aug baseline, which has no per-epoch real val) uses best_val_maskmAP5095.pt on both sides. All other checkpoints reported as secondary; none may be re-chosen after any test result.
test_policy: test split is never read during training, model selection or recipe decisions; test evaluation requires a separately LOCKED evaluation procedure and the final selected checkpoints
smoke_policy: smoke runs may (a) override epochs or (b) keep epochs=200 and stop after N epochs (to validate the 200-epoch LR schedule); written under a SMOKE root; never used as results
